gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with CHEUNG WAN STREET and running in a south south-easterly direction for about 360 metres before it bends to run in an east north-easterly direction for about 75 metres where it terminates at its junction with CHEUNG FAI ROAD as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R102B.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與長環街交界處起，向東南偏南伸展約三百六十米，再轉向東北偏東伸展約七十五米，至與長輝路交界處止。在NTA/TW/R102B號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with CHEUNG TAT ROAD and running in an east north-easterly direction for about 75 metres where it terminates at its junction with CHEUNG FAI ROAD as shown coloured red on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R102B.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由與長達路交界處起，向東北偏東伸展約七十五米，至與長輝路交界處止。在NTA/TW/R102B號圖則上以紅色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with CHEUNG WAN STREET and running in a generally south south-easterly direction for about 495 metres before it bends to run in a generally southerly direction for about 300 metres where it terminates as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R102B.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與長環街交界處起，向東南偏南伸展約四百九十五米，再大致轉向南伸展約三百米，然後終止。在NTA/TW/R102B號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road extending as a continuation of TSING YI ROAD (which was published under Government Notice No. 1702 dated 6 July 1979) and running in north-westerly direction for about 220 metres and then bends to run in a south-westerly direction for about 740 metres; it bends again to run in a generally northerly direction for about 1 265 metres where it temporarily terminates at its junction with SAI TSO WAN ROAD as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R102B.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路作為延長現存之青衣路（於一九七九年七月六日刊載於憲示一七零二號），向西北伸展約二百二十米，後轉向西南伸展約七百四十米，再轉向北伸展約一千二百六十五米，然後在西草灣路交界處暫時終止。在NTA/TW/R102B號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with TSING YI ROAD and running in a north-westerly direction for about 115 metres and then bends to run in a generally northerly direction for about 385 metres; it bends again to run in a west north-westerly direction for about 190 metres where it terminates as shown coloured red on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R102B.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與青衣路交界處起，向西北伸展約一百一十五米，再大致轉向北伸展約三百八十五米，然後向西北偏西伸展約一百九十米，然後終止。在NTA/TW/R102B號圖則上以紅色標明。
